name: Amco India Limited
about: Amco India Limited manufactures and sells PVC leather cloth and aluminum foils in India. The company offers PVC leather cloth for furnishing, sports shoes/goods, belt, and wallet applications; and PVC films and sheeting for shower curtains, side door panels/sun visor, stationary, insulation tapes, and rainwear. It also provides laminated foils; and blister pack and strip pack plain. The company serves commercial, industrial, pharmaceutical, and food processing industries. Amco India Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Noida, India.
